Cloud - Google for Startups
Supercharge your growth with the Google for Startups Cloud Program
Get financial, technical, and business benefits that scale with you. The Google for Startups Cloud Program provides your startup with access to product and technical support, dedicated mentors, industry experts, Google Cloud and Firebase costs covered up to $200,000 (up to $350,000 for AI startups) over your first two years in the program, and more.

Google
benefits
to help you thrive
Start
If you’re early in your startup journey and not yet backed with startup equity funding, you can receive up to
$2,000 USD in credits*
to use over a year to help your startup get up and running on Google Cloud, along with
access to technical resources and our global startup community.
Receive additional Google product benefits to accelerate your startup’s growth—including Google Workspace discounts, Google Domains discount, and more.
Scale

Google Cloud and Firebase usage covered with credits up to $100,000, plus 20% of Google Cloud and Firebase usage costs covered in year two (up to an additional $100,000 in credits).*

AI-first startups
can take advantage of our open AI ecosystem and tap into the best of Google’s infrastructure, AI products, and foundation models. You can receive up to $350,000 USD in cloud cost coverage, dedicated AI training, webinars, and more.

and startups can focus on innovation over infrastructure while building decentralized apps, Web3 tooling, services and more.

Long-term cost savings

Going

Google for Startups helps founders navigate every step of their startup journey — far beyond the end of a program. Learn more about how we support startups as they start, build, and grow.
We’re committed to supporting startup communities around the world so founders everywhere can turn big ideas into successful businesses. Find out how we do it.
Ongoing support
Google for Startups support doesn’t stop when a program ends. Once you’ve joined our community, we are invested in your long term success. Founders that complete one of our mentor-based programs automatically become part of our alumni network, so you can stay connected to the Google for Startups team and our global community.
Our alumni can always request support from tech and product teams at Google, and access new learning and networking opportunities.

Online and in-person meetups with local Google for Startups alumni communities.
Expert-led panels and open discussions with thought leaders from Google and the founder ecosystem.
A quarterly newsletter curated to the needs and interests of the Google for Startups alumni community.

About

A global series of programs
Each accelerator features a cohort of 10-15 top startups that come together to tackle specific technical challenges that can help grow their businesses through a mix of remote and in-person, 1-to-1, group learning sessions, and sprint projects.
Dedicated expert help

The Gemini Startup Forum is designed as an intimate, two-day in-person gathering that fosters deep connections and unique insight sharing among a global community of like-minded founders and top AI experts from Google.
The initiative aims to facilitate deep, substantive conversations on the practical application and strategic integration of AI. This is not a typical conference; it is a collaborative exploration into how AI will redefine your industry, transform your company, and unlock unprecedented growth.

Gemini Startup Forum is an application based event for Seed to Series A startup founders who are committed to integrating AI as a core pillar of their growth strategy. Attendees are selected to ensure a high-caliber, collaborative environment.

conditions_summary: Başvuru sahiplerinin bir startup kurucusu veya ekip üyesi olması, yapay zekayı ürün veya operasyonlarında kullanmayı planlaması ve API'lerle çalışabilecek teknik kapasiteye sahip olması gerekmektedir.
body_chunk:
Gemini API Sprints: Build with AI hand in hand with experts from Google. - Google for Startups
Global
Gemini API
Sprints
Ready to rapidly integrate AI into your startup? The Gemini API Sprints are immersive hands-on events where you’ll have the opportunity to get up to speed fast and learn how to quickly integrate Google AI, and scale your business with support from experts from Gemini.
Global
Gemini API
Sprints
About
the initiative
About
the initiative
The Gemini API Sprints are a unique series of intensive, full-day events designed to help startups leverage Gemini's power to build products and functionalities that can scale their businesses fast.
Held both online and in-person at select Google for Startups Campus spaces around the globe, these Sprints provide an unparalleled environment for real-time building. You'll work directly with experts from Google, transforming your ideas into tangible solutions and accelerating your product's journey with Google’s most capable AI models.
Key benefits
AI expert mentoring
Gain insights and technical advice directly from the engineers and product managers building Gemini.
Build your AI solution live
Leave the event with a working new AI feature prototype or a functional exploration of Gemini’s latest models.
Access the latest Google AI Models
Experiment with new features and capabilities from the latest Gemini models, enabling early testing and seamless integration into your product.
Founder Network
Build surrounded by a vibrant network of fellow founders and startup teams.
Who should join a Gemini API Sprint
Who should join a Gemini API Sprint
To ensure maximum impact for every attendee, participation in our Gemini API Sprints is application-based. We select attendees based on their readiness to leverage the opportunity, with the following requirements:
You are a founder or part of a startup team.
You are leveraging or planning to leverage AI in your product or operations.
You have an identified AI idea, project or product feature to build during the Sprint.
While deep AI expertise isn't required, teams should have some technical capacity to work with APIs and build out their idea during the Sprint.
